label: PostTagRepository.read_post_tags_by_post_id
answer:
found = self._store.select(self.ENTITY, [(self.PK, 'eq', post_id)])
    if not found:
        return []
    tag_ids = [post_tag['tag_id'] for post_tag in found]
    tags = self._store.select('Tag', [('tag_id', 'eq', tag_id) for tag_id in tag_ids])
    return [models.Tag(**tag) for tag in tags]
